gloss: letters column; reader submissions section; comments section

definitions.gloss: letters column; reader submissions section; comments section
definitions.explanation: a section in a newspaper, magazine, or website where reader-submitted content is published

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投稿欄|とうこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent my opinion to the newspaper's letters column.

examples.japanese: {投稿欄|とうこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: The letters section features a variety of reader voices.

examples.japanese: {朝日新聞|あさひしんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投稿欄|とうこうらん}「⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寄|よ}せられる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧。
examples.english: The Asahi Shimbun's letters column 'Koe' receives many submissions every day.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧ (submission, contribution) and ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, section). Refers to the section of a publication where reader letters and opinions appear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投稿欄|とうこうらん}: newspaper letters column
- {投稿欄|とうこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧: to submit to the letters column
- {投稿欄|とうこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}される→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧: to be published in the letters section
- ⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧{投稿欄|とうこうらん}: reader submissions column

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese newspapers have prominent letters columns. The Asahi Shimbun's 「⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧」(Koe, "Voices") and the Yomiuri Shimbun's 「⟦{気流|きりゅう}→気流：27360_kiryuu⟧」(Kiryuu) are well-known examples where readers discuss current events and social issues.
